findings.finding: Candidate hash and copy are separate reads; destination digest is then freshly accepted rather than compared to the pinned candidate. Bound JSON inputs are also read after their initial hash without final recheck.
findings.source_counterexample: Approved bytes A pass H(candidate). Candidate changes to B before read_bytes. B is copied and row records H(B); final IMM comparison accepts B. This is a source trace, not an executed race.
findings.correction: Read/hash the exact bytes to be consumed; verify destination against the approved candidate digest; recheck initially bound inputs at completion.

findings.finding: Owned subprocess cleanup calls ACTIVE.wait() without a timeout and skips process-group cleanup if the leader already exited.
findings.source_counterexample: After guard failure, killed child can remain unreaped; wait has no remaining-time bound. Alternatively a leader exits while descendants remain; poll is non-None and group kill is skipped. No runtime example was executed.
findings.correction: Use bounded reap within remaining cleanup allowance, retain errors and descendant/ownership observations, and require outer cgroup termination before acceptance.

source_consistent_components: Pinned full Git revision and blob-only source selection
Fresh exclusive output/workspace creation and owned-only checkpoint writes
Archive digest equality to lock checksums; traversal/link/duplicate rejection; per-file vendor checksum generation
Fresh immutable and initial-cache manifests; copied cache bytes distinguished from source inputs
Live cgroup limits checked; disk/source/vendor/cache caps and lease/deadline guards present
release_obligations: Published reviewed preparation.json and supervisor with current lease/debit and resolved paths
Bounded outer runtime/stop/cgroup cleanup and durable outer result
Exact preparation tool identity, including git/findmnt, or explicit trusted-host assumption
No compiler/run admission from materializer source review
